resolved_ambiguities: R1 ARGS-DIFF: v1 names no pre-listed new keys for A1 vs D3-T, no reference for DIRECT-SYM ('its own reference for the plain path') and none for B1: ARGS_ALLOW / ARGS_REF are None there and the cell reads pending until Theory sets them (FAILURE at --final).

R2 G-L0 band rule: a band D is usable iff in every stream covering D: n_gate >= 5000, 0 invariant failures, chase first / random / maxdeg / la1 < 0.6, max_person_agnostic < 0.6, ubidir_max == 0.5 and beyond_D == 0 (the last two failing = CODE-BUG, band unusable). A decisive reading whose D range holds a failed band is UNREADABLE; DIRECT's C1 band is UNREADABLE if any of D 5-8 failed; descriptive readings exclude and list the band.
R3 PROBE(12) final-state validity is read on each reading's own pooling: the C1 band for PROBE-GAIN-L, D 4-8 for SERIAL-ONSET-L.
R4 SERIAL-STEP-L pooled bars include the pairs of D values excluded from the per-D bar (< 50 clean pairs); CF-L's excluded (D, j) cells (< 30) leave both the share and the Spearman.

R5 CF exposure = pos_ok and flip_ok; clean = ok_rec and ok_don at K' = D (fields, else derived from answers_by_t endpoints; endpoint mismatches are reported, not voiding). Within-D Spearman uses D with >= 2 distinct j after exclusion (D 4 has j = 3 only), weighted by clean pairs (v1_cf.py).

R6 CF labels: CF-CARRY = median t* == 1; CF-RECOMPUTE = median (D - t*) == 0; CF-FAST = median (j - t*) >= 2, over the used decisive pairs. LAST-HOP-LATE = CF-L met and median (D - t*) == 0 over clean j = D pairs (pure serial also reads it: v1 PS-6 says j = D cannot separate serial from recompute).
R7 RESET recovery = own rate (answer == y_rec) over clean exposed RESET pairs (no donor).

R8 KEEPS-SELF-STAB-L uses SELFDEPTH_v1 §4.3 in full (intact == acc part bitwise, CONTENT-STABILISES: STAB_bank >= 0.10 and STAB_dup_newest >= 0.10, STAB_self >= 0.5; mean over D 3..6), on A1 / A2 / A2-CTRL (DIRECT-SYM has no bank); unreadable or missing at --final = MEM-TRADED-L.

R9 A2-CTRL registered parts = acc + hist24 (its only readings: BEATS-CTRL input, ABSORB vs CTRL, MEM). At --final a2 a missing / censored / pending A2-CTRL fails BEATS-CTRL-L and SD-C2-L only (v1 §4.1 'A2-CTRL missing or censored -> SD-C2-L not met'), not every A2 reading.
R10 LABEL-BUG counts a wrong label under either GATE-1-L chain (S-L' holds for any labeller) or in LABEL-AUDIT-L; A2 launched -> VOID (rule b); not launched -> A2 GO false (UNREAD).
R11 No 'diverged' censor exists in v1 §5.2 for LANG cells (THEORY §218's header lists one); none is applied.
R12 NO-ENTRY is applied to DIRECT-SYM too (it logs plain_cand_ce); a censored DIRECT-SYM makes the C1 band UNREADABLE (VB-C1-L not met).

R13 CF-GSM: Addendum 1 item 6 applies 'the same cluster rule' and '>= 50 distinct items' to CF-GSM, but v1_gsm_exposure.json has only 37 exposed steps with j >= 3 (all non-last), so <= 37 base items: as registered CF-GSM (hence VB-C1-GSM) cannot pass on the real test set. Implemented literally (CF_GSM_MIN_BASE = 50); Theory to rule in a disclosed note before any B1 output.
R14 CF-GSM clustering: share = mean over base items of the per-item in-window share; Spearman on (base, j) cluster means of t* (pooled over j, not within m_bin); pair-level values reported beside.
R15 The ProsQA '>= 2,000 STALL items' minimum is not applied to GSM8K (879 items at m >= 3 could never reach it).

R16 ONE-PASS-CHAIN-L = some readable FD probe (lin or MLP) with FD(1, k>=3) >= 0.8 FD(k, k) pooled; LAST-STEP-LATE (GSM, descriptive) = median t* >= 12 over clean j = m_bin pairs (the LATE-FUSION-GSM threshold).

R17 CAUSAL-DEEP-L applies §217's rule to both ii_prime and i_prime (follow >= 0.95, own <= 0.02 pooled over B, every D in B follow >= 0.90) plus STALL >= 0.95; B = {D 9..16 : acc_d2 >= 0.95}; D with < 100 clean pairs in either arm or < 500 STALL items excluded; empty B = NOT-APPLICABLE. Pooled STALL = n-weighted.
R18 B GO uses the MEM status of every Stage A cell already scored (A1 always; A2 / A2-CTRL when not pending / UNREAD).
R19 GSM vswap file follow / own are compared with the pair-level recompute (v1 §4.2 predates Addendum 1); decisions read the clustered means.

R20 VB-C1-L wording: v1 §5.1's CF clause is replaced by Addendum 1 item 2's fixed wording ('hop-indexed consumption on >= 0.75 of clean exposed pairs (calibrated: requires ~0.9 item-level serial share)'); Stage B wording 'C4 via distillation from CoT, with CoT-parsed pointer annotations' (Addendum 1 item 1).
R21 RNN-IN-FUNCTION / HISTORY-USED (v1 §5.1 constraint check) have no field in the §4.1 contract; read from an optional slva_diag part if present, else reported 'not in the field contract'.
R22 PROBE extension rule (v1 §2.5): steps_run must be 10000 or 20000, and 10000 is invalid when the curve gains > 0.02 between 8k and 10k (PROBE(t) VOID).
R23 GSM8K decisive pair readings (SERIAL-STEP-GSM, CF-GSM) use only recipients whose base item has m >= 3 (v1 §4.2 'band m >= 3'); the m = 2 exposed item's pairs are reported pair-level only.
R24 G-L0 band failures also gate A2's own readings by D range (ABSORB 9-12, LENGTH / K'24 3-8, D 13-16, the MARGIN bar's A1 9-12).
R25 A CF (D, j) cell with > 400 exposed pairs (v1 §2.5 'up to 400') is flagged, not voided (more pairs do not bias the reading).

R26 ARGS_MUST holds the recipe values v1 states (A1 / DIRECT seed 1, 24,000 steps; A2 init_from A1, p_self 0.5, lr 3e-5, 12,000, self_kmax 16, seed 1; A2-CTRL p_self 0, self_pool none; B1 seed 1, 120,000); A2's 'c 0' has no stated c_sched string and is not asserted.
R27 PATHS (G-L0, G-EVMEM, GATE-1-L, pool, B0-2, interim GO) are not named in v1; the names here are assumptions for Experiments to match or edit.
R28 A1 is pending until DIRECT-SYM's cell is decided (not only until eval_direct.json exists), since a censored DIRECT-SYM voids the band.
R29 PROBE / FD / swap / CF per-item stores are required (v1 §4 'every share or threshold has its per-item / per-pair outputs stored'); GSM future items are not listed in §4.2 and are not required.

R30 Stage A items_sha reference = G-L0's test_items_sha if it records one (the built g_l0.json does not), else A1's file-level test sha; DIRECT-SYM / A2 / A2-CTRL must match it. Experiments' eval records one per-D test_sha per file (not per part, as v1 §4.3 asks): accepted as file-level, reported.

R31 Both field layouts are read (aliases only, no reading changes): LAYOUTS' names and Experiments' langvb_eval names as of 15:10 (per-pair 'exposed', int y_hyb, cf.cells + selected pairs with clean / tstar / clean_k2, fd_slot_scores, fd_valid {s: {model}}, plant items {D: [...]}, causal_deep stall rows, top-level card / dtype / eval_bs / test_sha, eval_direct nested under 'direct', the G-L0 panel layout at scratch/gate_s218/g_l0.json). With a selected-only CF store, n_candidates / n_exposed per (D, j) come from the file (flagged), n_clean / shares / t* are recomputed.
fixture_only_config: ARGS_REF / ARGS_ALLOW for direct / a1 / b1 set by configure() (v1 pre-lists none; the shipped scorer keeps None -> pending)
